verdict.rationale: Postmark provides documented batch endpoints (/email/batch, /email/batchWithTemplates, /email/bulk) for sending many emails at once, plus a TypeScript Promise.allSettled example showing per-recipient error handling for bulk operations, and batch template sending. This covers the core AI-native bulk-operation use case for email sending at scale.  missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of batch limits/performance, and bulk operations for non-email resources (e.g., bulk template management, bulk server config) beyond sending.
